title: J.B. Monge Kickstarts Celtic Faeries
content: At long last, Montreal-based artist J.B. Monge is offering a collectable book version of his charming Celtic Faeries universe. For many years Monge's artwork has only been available in expensive French imports, but now it will come out in a slipcased book, with lots of new artwork and an English translation. The campaign has already funded in little over a day!(Link to Kickstarter)
